annotations.title: Get the text of a statement

description: Get the text of one statement (wypowiedź) from the transcript (stenogram) of a plenary sitting, as plain text.

date.description: Day of the sitting (one of the `dates` of the sitting in get-proceedings), in YYYY-MM-DD format

proceeding.description: Number of the plenary sitting (posiedzenie Sejmu): the `number` field from get-proceedings

statementNum.description: Number of the statement: the `num` field from get-transcripts; 0 is the course of the sitting

term.description: Term of the Sejm (kadencja), e.g. 10; defaults to the current term (see get-terms)

name: get-statement
title: Get the text of a statement
